confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregator and crowd-sourced price pages with mixed dates, some from 2023-2024, so treat them as rough. Wine by the glass had no direct price found and is estimated from the beer and bottle-price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings. FX: the 0.6976 USD_PER_AUD observation for 2026-11-03 was taken from third-party reporting that cites RBA 4pm reference rates; I did not open rba.gov.au directly, and it may not be the latest RBA observation for 2026-11-19.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized Austrian and central European tourist cities with comparable restaurant prices and summer festival-season hotel demand, with the Salzburg food anchors anchored to 2026 aggregator restaurant and cafe price ranges.
